title: Médico Neurologista
description:
OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO NEUROLOGISTA/RESIDENTE NA TELADOC HEALTH"
Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!
A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos
Neurologista,
que esteja cursando Residência, ou Especialização, ou que já tenha concluído a formação. Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.
*
SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH:
*
A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.
*
O QUE PROCURAMOS:
*
Nosso time de médicos desempenham um papel crucial no suporte dos pacientes, para sanar suas dúvidas, atender as demandas de saúde de acordo com a necessidade de cada um, através de nossa plataforma online. Se você é um profissional licenciado, focado em resultados e apaixonado por fazer a diferença na vida dos pacientes, queremos conhecer você!
O médico será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo em duas modalidades: Clínico Generalista, de acordo com a dinâmica de solicitações e consultas de especialidade em Neurologia, ambos de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;
DESCRIÇÃO DE ATIVIDADES
Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Neurologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.
Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios neurológicos.
Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anamneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em Neurologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.
Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais neurológicos através de videochamadas.
Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.
Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.
Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças neurológicas.
Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.
Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.
Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.
Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde em Neurologia.
Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.
Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.
Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.
Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.
Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.
Manter-se bem informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.
Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.
FORMAÇÃO ACADEMICA (será solicitado comprovação de documentos):
Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA

title: Lead AI Success & Solutions
description:
About the Company
RapidCanvas is the trusted partner for transforming your business with AI. We offer the only hybrid enterprise AI platform that combines autonomous agents with human experts to make enterprise-grade AI accessible to all organizations—without the massive investment or deep technical expertise it used to take. Our unique approach delivers measurable business outcomes 10X faster at 80% lower cost, helping global leaders in manufacturing, retail and consumer goods, financial services, and infrastructure turn what was once impossible into practical, everyday reality.
About the Role
RapidCanvas is hiring customer-facing specialists focusing on
AI Success & Solutions
to lead end-to-end delivery of bespoke AI projects—from initial solution design through full customer success ownership. This role merges the depth of a Solutions Architect with the accountability of a Customer Success leader. You will work across pre-sales and post-sales, ensuring our clients see real business value from our AI capabilities. The hiring seniority level will depend on the candidate’s depth of experience across customer-facing solution delivery, ability to drive measurable business impact, and demonstrated ownership in ambiguous or fast-paced environments.
Responsibilities
Pre-Sale: Discovery & Solutioning
Partner with Sales and Data Science to deeply understand the customer’s business context and challenges.
Define clear problem statements, document current state processes, and align on success criteria and KPIs.
Design solution architecture and data flow diagrams tailored to each use case.
Assess data feasibility and AI-fit for the proposed use case.
Set up technical and collaboration workspaces (Slack, Drive, JIRA, etc.) with naming and access discipline.
Post-Sale: Execution & Success
Own the customer relationship post-sale, acting as the single point of accountability.
Manage the execution and implementation of the solution, ensuring clarity of scope, timeline, and handoffs.
Lead all internal and customer-facing check-ins, with clear agendas, follow-ups, and next-step ownership.
Facilitate UAT and deployment, ensuring measurable outcomes are validated.
Track and report on success metrics across 30/60/90-day milestones and ensure platform adoption.
Operational Excellence
Maintain rigorous documentation: dataset inventories, architectural diagrams, solution design docs, etc.
Ensure consistent file naming, visual branding, and version control across all customer-facing material.
Keep Slack, HubSpot, JIRA, and Confluence spaces current and synchronized.
Proactively escalate blockers, risks, or unclear ownership to leadership with proposed resolutions.
Strategic Growth
Identify expansion opportunities based on solution usage and customer success metrics.
Collaborate with Product to feed back client needs and usage patterns into roadmap priorities.
Act as a trusted strategic advisor to the client, helping them envision and prioritize future AI investments.
Qualifications
At least six (6) years in a hybrid technical+customer-facing role (Solutions Architect, Customer Success, Engagement Manager, etc.).
Strong understanding of applied Data Science, ML, GenAI (e.g., LLM Prompting, RAG).
Demonstrated success delivering AI or data-driven solutions in a consulting or startup setting.
Excellent storytelling and business value articulation skills for both technical and executive audiences.
Detail-oriented with exceptional project management and follow-through.
Global client experience is strongly preferred.
Prior experience in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment with high expectations for ownership and delivery.
Professional fluency in English is required.
Why Join Us
Drive measurable impact for Fortune 500 customers across the globe, helping them turn AI vision into operational value. Be part of a category-defining AI company, pioneering a hybrid model that bridges agents and experts. Own strategic accounts end-to-end and shape what modern AI success looks like. Work with a cross-functional, high-performance team that values execution, clarity, and outcomes. Globally competitive compensation and benefits tailored to your local market. Recognized as a Top 5 Data Science and Machine Learning platform on G2 for customer satisfaction.
Pay range and compensation package
Globally competitive compensation and benefits tailored to your local market.

RapidCanvas is committed to diversity and inclusivity.

title: Head of Engineering
description:
Come Make an Impact on Millions of Brazilians!
Do you want to make a difference in the lives of millions of Brazilians? At RecargaPay, we create accessible and innovative financial solutions that transform how people interact with money. Join us on this journey of impact and innovation, connecting people with opportunities that truly make a difference in their daily lives.
Our purpose is to provide the best mobile payment experience for Brazilians by solving real problems with smart solutions—such as Pix Parcelado—while staying ahead of market trends and customer needs. Here, we value collaboration, ownership, and a relentless pursuit of results, always striving for excellence in every interaction.
If you're looking to be part of a dynamic environment that challenges the status quo and puts people at the center of decision-making, RecargaPay is the perfect place for you to grow, co-create, and impact lives!
Position Overview
As Head of Engineering, you will serve as the senior-most technology leader within a tribe, responsible for defining and executing the technical strategy that supports the product vision and business goals. You’ll work as a peer to the Squad Leaders, who focus on product and business priorities, and report functionally to the Tribe Lead while maintaining a strong dotted-line relationship with the VP of Engineering.
This role blends deep technical expertise with organizational leadership and strategic influence. You will lead and develop a group of Engineering Managers and Technical Leads, ensure scalable and maintainable system design, promote a culture of technical excellence, and drive alignment across squads within your tribe. Your success will be measured not only by delivery outcomes but also by your ability to develop high-performing teams and align engineering execution with the broader objectives of the company.
Responsibilities
Lead and scale a team of engineers, promoting a culture of technical excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement.
Remain actively involved in system architecture decisions and complex problem-solving
Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and other stakeholders to ensure alignment between business goals and technology execution.
Assist to define and drive engineering best practices across development, testing, deployment, and observability.
Mentor engineers and technical leaders, fostering career growth and technical development.
Participate in technical hiring and help shape the team structure and engineering processes.
Promote the adoption of AI-assisted engineering practices within your squad and chapter, leveraging tools for code generation, automated refactoring, test case creation, and technical documentation. Identify opportunities where AI can enhance developer productivity, code quality, and team velocity.
Guides conversations to remove blockers and encourage collaboration in your team.
Define and drive the technical vision and strategy of the tribe, ensuring alignment with business objectives and long-term platform evolution.
Partner with Squad Leaders and Product counterparts to shape roadmaps, identify trade-offs, and prioritize delivery.
Mentor and develop Engineering Managers, Staff Engineers, and Tech Leads, fostering leadership maturity and technical growth across squads.
Promote high standards in software architecture, observability, reliability, and scalability across systems and services.
Ensure that teams are resourced, structured, and supported to deliver value with speed and quality.
Actively contribute to talent strategy: hiring, succession planning, career development, and performance management of engineering leadership.
Serve as the primary interface between engineering and the Tribe Lead, supporting delivery accountability and risk management.
Collaborate with the VP of Engineering and other Heads of Engineering to uphold chapter-wide standards and contribute to global engineering strategy.
Guide architectural decisions and governance, facilitating technical forums and peer reviews at tribe level.
Champion the use of AI-assisted development tools and modern engineering practices to improve productivity, maintainability, and code quality.
Establish and monitor key technical KPIs (reliability, velocity, tech debt, performance) across squads to drive continuous improvement.
Lead by example in cultivating an inclusive, empowering engineering culture rooted in ownership, impact, and continuous learning.
Requirements
Academic background in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related disciplines.
Deep technical expertise in Java, Spring Boot, relational databases, distributed systems, AWS, and microservices.
Strong software quality practices including clean architecture, automated testing, performance optimization, and observability.
Proven engineering leadership experience managing teams, engineering managers, and building layered leadership structures within product-centric technology companies.
Strategic execution skills in defining OKRs/KPIs, prioritizing technical initiatives, and managing budgets and infrastructure.
Excellent cross-functional collaboration with Product, Design, Business, and Ops to align technical direction with business goals.
Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., code generation, test automation, intelligent documentation).
Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
Comfortable operating in dynamic, fast-paced environments and leading through influence, vision, and technical credibility.
Track record of hiring, mentoring, and developing engineering talent, including technical leads and managers.
Committed to building inclusive, psychologically safe, and growth-oriented team environments.
Experienced in driving knowledge sharing, promoting engineering best practices, and enabling continuous learning across teams.
Soft Skills
Communicates effectively across all levels, translating complex technical and strategic priorities for both engineers and executives.
Builds inclusive, empowering environments, fostering psychological safety, ownership, and cross-boundary collaboration.
Leads through influence, mobilizing cross-functional teams around clear visions and navigating change with composure and adaptability.
Develops strong leaders and teams via mentorship, growth opportunities, and high-performance culture.
Ensures engineering alignment and execution, resolving blockers, managing ambiguity, and making data-informed, high-quality decisions.
Shapes strategic technical direction, aligning engineering goals with business strategy while balancing short-term delivery and long-term growth.
Industry-Specific Knowledge
As Head of Engineering, you bring deep, hands-on familiarity with one or more core financial domains, such as lending, payments, credit cards, open finance, fraud prevention, merchant acquiring, or investment services, paired with a strategic understanding of the operational workflows, regulatory constraints, and economic drivers that define these industries.
You leverage this expertise to ensure that engineering execution is tightly aligned with product strategy and business priorities. Beyond shaping technical direction, you act as a key partner to Squad Leaders, Product Managers, and Tribe leadership, collaborating to define roadmaps, assess trade-offs, and guide decision-making that balances delivery velocity, platform health, and long-term business value.
Operating at scale, you oversee multiple engineering teams across the tribe, ensuring technical coherence, cross-squad alignment, and system-level resilience. You translate domain-specific needs into actionable technical direction and drive a culture in which engineering outcomes are measured not just by execution, but by their tangible impact on revenue growth, operational efficiency, regulatory readiness, and customer experience.
Benefits
Competitive and market-aligned salary plus bonus.
Remote work — wherever you are, you’re part of the team!
Home office allowance through a monthly deposit in the RecargaPay app.
Health and dental plans with no co-pay.
Life insurance.
Flexible meal allowance (via Flash).
TotalPass membership to take care of your health.
Spanish or Portuguese classes.
Diversity & Inclusion at RecargaPay
At RecargaPay, you’ll have the freedom to be who you are because we believe that diverse perspectives and experiences make us more creative and stronger. Here, everyone is welcome to express themselves authentically. We value the richness of each journey and the multiple ways of seeing the world, without distinctions of gender, race, sexual orientation, age, religion, or any other characteristic that makes us unique.
About the use of your Data
By sharing your resume with us, you authorize the use of your data for analysis during the selection process and possibly for other opportunities within the RecargaPay group. You can request the update or deletion of your information at any time, in accordance with LGPD (General Data Protection Law).

title: District Commercial Manager
description:
1. About us
Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to revolutionize food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage!
2. Responsibilities
Team Building and Empowerment
: Assist Keeta in establishing a food delivery sales team in new cities, starting from scratch to drive business expansion. Through systematic one-on-one or group training and empowerment models, rapidly enhance the team's capabilities and ensure the achievement of business goals.
System Development and Optimization
: Establish and maintain smooth communication channels within and outside the team. Continuously optimize team operational mechanisms based on different stages of business development to strengthen the team’s professional expertise.
Cultural Integration and Team Building
: Demonstrate the ability to manage multicultural teams effectively and build a high-performance team that aligns with the company's core values.
Goal Setting and Alignment
: Combine senior leadership requirements with the team's actual situation, conduct comprehensive assessments and provide feedback, clarify work objectives, and set phased goals according to timelines.
Process Management and Tracking
: Utilize a mature Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) framework to ensure smooth operations at the frontline. Adjust strategies promptly based on business progress to ensure process management meets requirements.
Outcome Achievement and Review
: Ensure work objectives are achieved successfully. Conduct reviews of work processes, explore more efficient methods, summarize experiences, and accumulate valuable insights for future work.
Time Management and Optimization
: Clearly define time management priorities for the role and different levels, and optimize personal time management based on actual circumstances.
3. Basic Requirements
Management Experience
: Has experience in managing sales teams, with outstanding performance in another company over the past year.
Team Leadership Methods
: Ability to clearly articulate methods for leading teams to success, with proven, replicable experience in overseas markets.
Experience Sharing
: Actively share work experiences and provide actionable improvement suggestions to help the team quickly enhance their capabilities.
Strategic Thinking
: Possess a holistic mindset with the ability to clearly plan business and team development pathways. When facing challenges, accurately identify root causes and coordinate between headquarters and various teams to resolve issues swiftly.
Focus on Talent Development
: Prioritize talent growth, having previously served as a corporate trainer or established a training system within the team.
Motivation and Resilience
: Demonstrate strong ambition and professionalism, willingness to challenge oneself, and the ability to handle work-related pressure effectively.
Language Proficiency
: Fluent in English and Portuguese (speaking, listening, reading, and writing), with the ability to adapt to long-term overseas work and travel.
4. Job Highlights
Join us to witness the rapid growth of Meituan's global food delivery business and experience firsthand the industry transformation and growth miracles. You will collaborate with a world-class, diverse team, fostering innovative thinking, expanding your international perspective, and deepening your expertise. This is not just a job—it's an unparalleled opportunity to achieve personal growth, realize your self-worth, and drive global business innovation.

Estamos procurando uma ou um Product Manager para liderar iniciativas estratégicas que impactam diretamente como restaurantes operam, se conectam com seus clientes e tomam decisões de negócio.

Você será responsável por transformar dores reais dos nossos clientes em soluções digitais inteligentes, escaláveis e centradas no usuário. Irá atuar junto aos times de engenharia, design, dados e atendimento em um ambiente ágil, dinâmico e com autonomia para experimentar.

Coletar e priorizar demandas com base em dados, feedbacks e alinhamento estratégico.
Criar documentos de produto claros (roadmaps, epics, user stories, critérios de aceitação).
Colaborar com desenvolvedores e designers para entregar experiências de ponta.
Acompanhar métricas de adoção, uso, NPS e satisfação.
Contribuir com a visão de produto e com a evolução do stack de soluções da Risposta.
Requisitos
Experiência anterior como PM em produtos digitais (SaaS, B2B ou B2C).
Capacidade analítica e orientação a dados.
Excelente comunicação escrita e verbal.
Experiência com métodos ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e ferramentas como Jira, Figma, Notion.
Familiaridade com o setor de foodservice ou hospitalidade é um diferencial.
O que oferecemos
Ambiente de empresa sólida e em crescimento rápido.
Desafios reais com impacto no dia a dia de milhares de restaurantes e milhões de clientes.
Time colaborativo, com liberdade para propor e testar ideias.
Flexibilidade, transparência e foco em resultado.
Se você quer trabalhar com propósito, em um produto com escala nacional, ajudando restaurantes a oferecerem experiências memoráveis, vem conversar com a gente.

title: IT Service Level Manager
description:
BAT is evolving at pace into a global multi-category business. Our purpose is to create A Better TomorrowTM by Building a Smokeless World.
To achieve our ambition, we are looking for colleagues who are ready to join us on this journey! Tomorrow can’t wait, let’s shape it together!
British American Tobacco Brazil has an exciting opportunity for an IT Service Level Manager in Rio de Janeiro
The Service Level Manager (SLM) is responsible for ensuring that all IT services meet the agreed-upon service levels and performance standards. This role involves managing Service Level Agreements (SLAs), monitoring service performance, and working closely with both internal teams and external vendors to ensure high-quality service delivery. The SLM will play a crucial role in aligning IT services with business objectives and customer expectations.
The position requires strong alignment with ITIL best practices, COBIT governance principles, and industry performance benchmarks. The SLM is also a key agent in driving continuous improvement, digital transformation, and the innovation of user-centric services.
Your key responsibilities will include:
Develop, negotiate, and manage SLAs with internal and external stakeholders and monitor and report on service performance against SLAs.
Conduct regular reviews of SLAs to ensure they remain relevant and aligned with business needs.
Maintain a centralized and accessible Service Catalogue and being responsible for ITSM governance, for example, incident, change, problem and transition management.
Use data-driven insights to predict and prevent potential service disruptions and analyze service performance and structured root cause analysis data to identify trends and areas for improvement.
Manage capacity and delivery plan (internal and external teams)
Act as the primary point of contact for all service-related issues and escalations and communicate service performance and improvement plans to stakeholders.

title: Retention Specialist
description:
About Hearth
Hearth is a Fintech company helping home improvement contractors grow and manage their business. Our SaaS platform provides over 14,000 contractors the financial tools they need to close more business, including financing solutions, invoicing, payment collections, insurance products, all in one, modern system designed specifically for the home improvement industry.
Backed by 8VC, Founders Fund, and other prominent leaders in Silicon Valley, Hearth has raised over $50M and is one of the fastest growing companies in the home improvement space.
The Mission
To us, the home improvement contractor is a true embodiment of the American Dream – skilled craftspeople who choose to start their own business to build a better life for their families and their communities.
While home improvement professionals power a $500 billion per year industry and protect the homes of millions of Americans, they are typically overlooked by Wall Street and Silicon Valley, and are one of the most underserved, undercapitalized, and written-off segments of entrepreneurs.
We built Hearth to tip the odds of success in their favor. Hearth is a seamless digital toolkit that helps home improvement pros win more projects, grow their sales, and save time running their business. In the last six years, we’ve built an industry-leading technology platform (Financing, Payments, Quotes, Contracts, and Banking), work with over 15,000 contractors, and have funded over $500 million in additional projects for home improvement pros. And, we are just getting started.
The Opportunity:
As a Retention Specialist at Hearth, you will play a critical role in our Customer Success team, focusing on managing inbound cancellations, running retention initiatives, and driving revenue growth. Your mission is to deeply understand our customers' needs, address their concerns, and use all available resources to retain their business. This role is ideal for someone who is motivated by results, resilient in challenging situations, and passionate about helping businesses succeed.
Why This Opportunity is Exciting:
The ideal candidate for this role is someone who is eager to leverage their unique skills to significantly impact the customer experience while developing their career and expanding their influence within the company. This opportunity is not just a job—it's a chance to use your strengths to transform customer retention and influence the overall direction of how we assist our customers. You will have the ability to shape the top of the funnel through detailed data collection and reporting, becoming a pivotal member of the company. Your efforts will be recognized as key to driving rapid company growth, and you’ll be compensated based on your results, similar to a sales rep. This is a role where your contributions truly matter.
What We're Looking For:
We’re searching for someone who’s got a natural knack for sales—you know how to ask the right questions, dig deep, and truly understand what’s bothering our customers. You’re the type of person who doesn’t just stop at the surface but uses every tool at your disposal to find solutions that work. Cold calls? Tough conversations? They don’t scare you. In fact, you thrive in those moments, staying cool and collected no matter how challenging things get.
Curiosity is in your DNA. You’re genuinely interested in our customers and passionate about helping them succeed. When the going gets tough, you don’t shy away; instead, you roll up your sleeves and get the job done, no matter what it takes. Doing the right thing is important to you—even if it’s not the easiest or most popular choice.
You’re hungry for results and not just here to clock in and out. You’re driven to make a real impact, and you see your performance as the key to controlling your own income. And let’s be honest—you’re ambitious. You’re always looking for ways to grow, improve, and move up in your career.
What you’ll do: :
Customer Engagement:
Proactively reach out to customers who have requested cancellations or expressed dissatisfaction. Listen to their concerns, identify pain points, and offer personalized solutions to retain their business.
Issue Resolution:
Address and resolve customer issues in a timely and effective manner. Collaborate with internal teams to ensure that all customer concerns are fully resolved and documented.
Retention Strategies:
Develop and implement tailored retention strategies for different customer segments, utilizing data and customer feedback to continuously improve these approaches.
Renewal Assistance:
Assist customers with the renewal process, ensuring they fully understand the value of our services and the benefits of continuing their relationship with us.
Reporting & Analytics:
Track and report on retention metrics, customer feedback, and the effectiveness of retention strategies. Provide insights and recommendations to the Retention Manager.
Product Knowledge:
Stay up-to-date on all product features, updates, and industry trends to effectively communicate the value proposition to customers.
Collaboration:
Work closely with the Sales, Product, and Customer Success teams to share insights and ensure a cohesive approach to customer retention.
Upsell & Cross-Sell:
Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities that align with customer needs, contributing to revenue growth.
Qualifications:
2+ years of experience in customer service, sales, or a related field.
Strong foundation in customer-facing roles with excellent communication and active listening skills.
Proven track record of meeting or exceeding quotas/KPIs.
Experience with Salesforce or similar CRM systems.
Ability to handle high-volume, fast-paced phone interactions with resilience.
Problem-solving and conflict resolution skills.
Adaptability to a fast-changing environment with attention to detail and consistent follow-through.
Customer-centric mindset with a genuine desire to help businesses succeed.
Preferred:
Experience in the Home Improvement/Construction vertical or adjacent fields
Our Core Values
Truth.
We value honesty and data. We seek to understand what is reality, so we can effectively respond to it.
Slope.
Rate of change over time. We hire and reward based on a team member’s potential, capacity, and growth-mindset, rather than a fancy resume.
Mutual Benefit.
The best outcomes happen when everyone wins - customers, team members, and the company. We seek to understand each other’s aspirations and create alignment to get there.
Competitive Greatness.
We desire an opportunity and environment from which to pull the greatest versions of ourselves out into the world, rather than just a “job”.
At Hearth, we value resilience, curiosity, and a strong drive for results. We recognize that retention can be challenging, but we believe in the power of addressing each customer's unique needs. If you're excited about making a real difference in how businesses operate and grow, we want to hear from you!

description:
Olá, somos a SuperFrete :)
Queremos ser a maior e mais amada rede de logística digital, quer fazer parte disso?
Somos uma startup que atua no segmento do varejo e logística, apoiando os pequenos e médios empreendedores a se tornarem mais competitivos no mercado e a alavancarem suas vendas. Por isso, buscamos um(a)
Super Especialista em RevOps , que se identifique com o nosso propósito, que tenha muita energia, para somar no time e que queira crescer (muito!) com a gente.
Responsabilidades:
Gerenciar, configurar e otimizar a plataforma HubSpot para melhorar o marketing, vendas e atendimento ao cliente entre a SuperFrete e seus clientes. Por isso, você será responsável por criar e implementar estratégias avançadas de personalização, segmentação e automação alinhado à estratégia de comunicação. Seu papel envolve não apenas a gestão e análise de dados, mas também a inovação constante das abordagens de CRM, influenciando diretamente os resultados da empresa. Além disso, você terá a responsabilidade de colaborar com outras áreas e liderar projetos, sempre visando otimizar a experiência do cliente e gerar valor contínuo para o negócio.
No dia a dia, você vai:
HubSpot: Gerenciar e otimizar ferramentas de CRM e automação de marketing na HubSpot, garantindo que sejam utilizadas ao máximo de seu potencial; Avaliar e implementar novas tecnologias que possam melhorar as campanhas de CRM e o uso dos dados; Implementar medidas de segurança e compliance dentro da HubSpot; Integrar a HubSpot com outras ferramentas conversacionais; Acompanhar atualizações e lançamentos na HubSpot para implementar e otimizar estratégias.
Arquitetura de sistemas e integrações: Garantir que a plataforma de CRM seja integrada com outros sistemas da SuperFrete para otimização de processos.
Personalização e dados: Criar e configurar workflows automatizados e pipelines; Criar relatórios customizados; Personalizar objetos, campos e dashboards; Gerenciar a organização dos dados na HubSpot; Implementar estratégias de lead scoring; Analisar comportamentos e padrões de compra dos clientes, segmentando a base de acordo com características comportamentais e demográficas.
Estratégias de CRM: Criar e implementar estratégias avançadas de relacionamento com o cliente, focadas em personalização, segmentação e otimização da experiência do cliente; Gerar e nutrir novos leads; Desenvolver e monitorar programas de fidelização e retenção de clientes, utilizando dados para ajustar as estratégias conforme o comportamento do público; Criar jornadas do cliente baseadas em dados, visando aumentar a lealdade, reduzir churn e aumentar o lifetime value.
Dados e relatórios: Analisar dados de jornada do cliente na HubSpot e Power BI; Criar dashboards e relatórios detalhados na HubSpot; Monitorar continuamente o desempenho das ações e operação de todas as frentes dentro da HubSpot, propor melhorias nas estratégias, com base em análises, feedback dos clientes e tendências de mercado, para aumentar a eficácia da experiência do cliente.
Suporte às outras equipes: Colaborar com as equipes de Marketing, Vendas, Produto e Atendimento ao cliente para garantir a consistência das estratégias e alinhamento de objetivos; Participar de reuniões estratégicas com a liderança para compartilhar insights, alinhar objetivos e propor soluções baseadas em dados; Fornecer suporte a outras áreas no que diz respeito à coleta e análise de dados de clientes para otimização de processos; Criar estratégias de ativação, engajamento e retenção; Monitorar o comportamento dos usuários dentro do produto; Documentar todas as iniciativas implementadas entre as outras áreas.
Inovação: Acompanhar tendências e inovações no mercado de CRM, propondo novas soluções e abordagens para melhorar os processos da empresa; Testar novas funcionalidades e estratégias (ex.: inteligência artificial, machine learning, gamificação) para aprimorar a experiência do cliente e aumentar a eficácia das campanhas.
Governança: Garantir a governança dos dados, mantendo a integridade e qualidade das informações no CRM (Plataforma).
Requisitos:
Habilidades técnicas
Domínio da HubSpot: Experiência avançada com a HubSpot; Experiência em configurar e integrar plataformas de CRM com outras ferramentas de dados e marketing, assegurando a centralização e qualidade dos dados. Habilidade para fazer análises de jornada dos usuários na HubSpot, para identificar problemas de fluxos, pipelines e bugs; Habilidade para trabalhar com dados de clientes, coletando, organizando a arquitetura de dados.
Automações HubSpot: Experiência avançada para criar automações para disparos de comunicação; Habilidade para criação de fluxos de pipelines; Criação de fluxos para alimentar/atualizar propriedades e outros; Habilidade com lógica para criação de automação de fluxos de comunicação.
Segmentação e personalização na HubSpot: Conhecimento avançado de variáveis e lógicas de ferramentas para segmentar base de usuários; Experiência na criação de objetos personalizados; Experiência em criação de propriedades para segmentação de base; Capacidade de criar campanhas mais segmentadas e personalizadas, entendendo melhor o comportamento dos clientes e adaptando as comunicações a diferentes públicos.
Análise avançada de jornada do cliente: Habilidade para compreender as necessidades e expectativas dos clientes; Entendimento da jornada do cliente e uso de dados para identificar pontos de contato e otimizar o ciclo de vida do cliente.
Comunicação e gestão de projetos: Capacidade de projetar e executar processos repetíveis e eficientes em grande escala; Habilidade de trabalhar em conjunto com equipes de vendas, marketing e suporte ao cliente; Boa comunicação para entender as necessidades de usuários internos e propor soluções adequadas.
Habilidades comportamentais
Curiosidade: Capacidade de antecipar problemas, sugerir melhorias e agir antes que as oportunidades sejam perdidas.
Pensamento crítico: Ser capaz de analisar cenários para identificar problemas rapidamente, avaliar opções e sugerir soluções.
Orientação a resultados: Foco constante em alcançar metas e KPIs definidos.
Capacidade analítica: Habilidade de interpretar dados e transformar insights em ações concretas.
Atenção aos detalhes: Cuidado meticuloso com a operação de CRM.
Comunicação, negociação e priorização: Ser claro e objetivo ao comunicar insights, resultados e estratégias, tanto para a equipe interna quanto para stakeholders.
O que você pode esperar dos Supers?
Uma cultura de muita confiança, colaboração, focada em resultados, com muita autonomia e transparência;
Buscamos excelência em tudo o que fazemos, por isso estamos sempre aprendendo;
Temos vontade de construir junto, fazer a diferença e gerar impacto.
O que oferecemos:
Modelo de contratação: PJ;
‍‍ Modelo de trabalho 100% remoto: uma oportunidade de crescimento acessível para talentos em todo o Brasil;
Plano de Saúde: mantenha-se saudável com nosso abrangente plano de saúde nacional com consultas online e presenciais;
‍‍ GymPass/Wellhub: bem-estar completo para você cuidar da sua saúde física e mental com os aplicativos integrados;

Cultura colaborativa: nossa cultura é baseada na confiança, parceria e foco em resultados. Oferecemos um ambiente com autonomia e transparência;
Incentivo ao desenvolvimento: estamos comprometidos com a excelência e o aprendizado contínuo. Oferecemos avaliações semestrais, conversas de one-on-one, feedbacks construtivos, e muito mais;
Programa de Stock Option: possibilidade de se tornar sócio da empresa que foi reconhecida como uma das Startups mais promissoras do Brasil na lista 100 Startups to Watch. Se você está determinado a avançar em sua carreira, este é o lugar certo para você!

title: Supply Chain Analyst - Remote
description:
Recognized as the leading software development company in the Americas, our client offers 100% remote modality and an excellent work environment where employees can thrive, and work in multicultural teams, with flexible schedules and endless growth opportunities.
About the Role:
We are looking for a Supply Chain Analyst to join our team and help drive our growth. As a Supply Chain Analyst, you will play a critical and active role in the day-to-day operations. This is an excellent opportunity to be one of the key members of our team and position yourself for unique career growth opportunities.
What You’ll Do:
- Determine supply needs for products and services and research potential suppliers.

  • Act as a link and communicate pricing and performance needs to vendors and suppliers.
  • Participate in negotiations of favorable procurement contracts and prices with selected vendors and suppliers.
  • Select the most suitable suppliers in terms of reliability, product quality, and cost-efficiency.
  • Maintain and update a list of suppliers and their qualifications, delivery times, and potential future development.
  • Prepare cost-benefit analysis reports for review by managers.
    Here’s what we are looking for:
    - 2+ years experience in a supply management role or related position.
  • Knowledge of SAP or SAP B1.
  • Degree in supply chain management, logistics, business management, or related fields.
  • Experience in managing inventory.
  • SQL analysis tools and mathematical analysis.
  • Interpersonal skills and ability to build and improve trust.
  • Advanced English level.
    Benefits:
    - 100% remote work.
  • Flexible hours - make your own schedule!
  • Diverse and multicultural work environment.
  • Paid parental leave, vacation & holidays.
  • Hardware setup for you to work from home.
  • Excellent compensation — well above the market average.
  • Extensive opportunities for growth and professional development thanks to our mentoring system.
    Enjoy the opportunity to have a dynamic lifestyle, better health, and wellness. Find renewed passion in your job, improve your productivity, and benefit from attractive growth opportunities for your career.
    If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Analista de Seguros
description:
Sobre a Lockton
Fundada há mais de 50 anos por Jack Lockton em Kansas City, a Lockton desenvolveu uma marca internacionalmente reconhecida pela qualidade e eficiência nos serviços que oferecemos. Graças a lealdade de nossos clientes, que nos permitiu crescer expressivamente nos últimos anos, a Lockton hoje está entre as maiores corretoras de seguro do mundo, conquistando a taxa de crescimento orgânico mais rápida do mercado de corretoras
Responsabilidades e Atribuições:
Monitorar os prazos de renovação das apólices, garantir que todas as informações estejam atualizadas e corretas, tanto nos sistemas internos da Lockton quanto nas bases dos clientes.
Realizar verificações periódicas para evitar atrasos ou inconsistências que possam impactar o processo.
Inserir informações detalhadas e precisas sobre apólices, renovações, condições contratuais e observações importantes nos sistemas, assegurando a confiabilidade e integridade dos dados para suportar as operações comerciais e técnicas.
Criar materiais visuais, relatórios e planilhas que facilitem o acompanhamento dos processos de seguros, fornecendo informações claras para clientes, gestores e equipes internas. Preparar documentos que apoiem reuniões e tomadas de decisão.
Servir de ponto de contato entre as equipes comerciais, técnicas, de emissão e outras áreas internas da Lockton, acompanhando o andamento dos processos operacionais como emissão de documentos, ajustes contratuais e esclarecimento de dúvidas, garantindo fluidez e agilidade nas entregas.
Manter o arquivo digital de documentos atualizado e organizado, controlar prazos importantes para renovações e outras etapas do processo, acompanhar fluxos de trabalho para garantir o cumprimento dos prazos e conformidade com políticas internas e regulatórias.
Requisitos e Qualificações:
Ter atuado em corretora ou seguradora.
Desejável conhecimento em ramos elementares.
Inglês avançado
Sistema de trabalho: Híbrido - 3 dias presenciais e 2 de home office.

title: Head of Engineering
description:
CTO/Head of Engineering (Remote)
Are you someone who wants to empower and inspire others? Do you find yourself looking for opportunities for continuous learning and improvement? Are you driven by the satisfaction of completing tasks and achieving goals?
Are you seeking a mission-driven culture that fosters your professional growth? If so, we would love to connect with you!
Who We Are:
We are a remote team that improves online medical education and teaches healthcare professionals domestically and abroad how to save lives. We also take the same advanced life-saving training we developed for medical professionals and give it to underserved populations all around the world at no cost. We work in conjunction with the Disque Foundation to fulfill its mission of advancing healthcare education to the underserved through advanced technology
.
Check out our
website
:
Mission
is to provide free advanced healthcare education to underserved populations in the US and around the world.
Our Goal
is to empower 10 million people by 2025.
Our Values:
Dedication to “CANI” culture:
Constant and Never-Ending Improvement mentality.
Positive Focus/Resourceful/Gritty/Perseverance:
A self-starter who isn’t held back by a lack of direction or detailed instruction.
Impeccable Ball Handling Skills:
Responsibility, Accountability, Ownership.
Unwavering Integrity:
We Always do the Right Thing.
Who we’re looking for:
We seek an executive-level technology leader who is
visionary, strategic, and passionate about innovation
- without needing to be hands-on in coding. As a
CTO/Head of Engineering
, you will guide our tech and product strategy, ensuring alignment with business goals and fostering a culture of growth and servant leadership. This is a
hybrid role
combining strategic leadership with hands-on involvement. Approximately 25–30% of the time will be dedicated to implementation and debugging, while the remaining focus will be on system architecture, technical direction, and guiding internal teams.
Work directly with external vendors and partners to align on expectations and drive outcomes—this role does not involve formal vendor management but requires effective collaboration to ensure delivery meets our standards.
Why this role is unique:
We are
transitioning from in-house backend development to a third-party tech provider
to enhance scalability, security, and performance while reducing bugs and maintenance overhead. This is a
strategic shift
that allows us to focus on front-end improvements, marketing experiments, and product innovation. We need a leader excited about this transformation - someone who can refine product strategy, guide teams, and drive innovation rather than push for in-house backend development.
As a CTO/Head of Engineering, you will be responsible for:
Technology & Product Strategy
– Define and execute a long-term technology roadmap aligned with business goals and innovation.
Leadership & Growth
– Inspire, mentor, and empower teams to drive effective execution.
Product Ownership & Execution
– Oversee product evolution, ensuring front-end and API development supports user experience, marketing agility, and growth initiatives.
Security & Scalability
– Ensure site security, performance, and scalability by working with our third-party technology partner while keeping internal processes efficient.
Technical Escalation & Support
– Provide backup for critical issues and guide troubleshooting, ensuring smooth collaboration with third-party providers.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
– Collaborate with marketing, sales, and operations to leverage technology for business impact.
Vendor & Partner Management
– Manage relationships with external tech providers to maximize efficiency, reliability, and innovation.
You’ll thrive in this role if you are:
A visionary and servant leader who inspires teams and drives strategy.
Product-driven with business acumen, focusing on strategic impact rather than just technical execution.
Excited about transitioning to a third-party provider, focusing on innovation, scalability, and growth.
Technical but not hands-on daily, guiding decisions without coding every day.
Adaptable, proactive, and resourceful in navigating complex challenges.
A tech enthusiast passionate about AI and emerging technologies.
A strong communicator who can explain complex concepts to non-experts.
Remote-ready and thrive in a flexible, independent work environment.
Must-Have Experience
Leadership experience in a technology or product-focused executive role
Experience with Client side web development (HTML/CSS/JS/Smarty/Smarty Twig)
Deep understanding of front-end and API-driven development (modern JavaScript frameworks (e.g., React, AngularJS), CSS frameworks (e.g., Bootstrap, Foundation, UI Kit), component-based architecture, GraphQL)
Understanding of AWS, CDN, MariaDB, Apache HTTPd web servers, Linux, Cloud computing, CI/CD, cybersecurity
Experience working with Platform as a Service (PaaS) and API-driven environments
Security and scalability expertise in a digital product environment
Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and manage external technology vendors
Experience collaborating with external vendors to drive outcomes without direct management responsibility.
Nice to Have (or willingness to learn)
Cloudflare (maintenance, security, performance optimization)
WordPress, PHP, MySQL
GTM, on-site data tracking, SEO
Experience with automation tools, AI-driven tech, and experimentation platforms (e.g., VWO)
UX/UI familiarity (Figma, Adobe XD)
What This Role is NOT
A hands-on backend developer role.
A position for someone looking to rebuild everything in-house.
A rigid environment - our culture values adaptability, collaboration, and strategic thinking.
Additional Information:
This role is full-time, requiring 35-40 hours per week.
It is a fully remote contract position, with Independent Contractors responsible for their taxes and benefits.

title: Sales Manager
description:
Job Description
We’re looking for a
Sales Manager
to join our team in Rio de Janeiro and help shape the future of contextual advertising as we continue to expand globally.
Who We Are
At Seedtag, we lead the way in contextual advertising with our machine learning-powered platform. Our technology provides superior brand safety, human-like content understanding, and advanced cookieless targeting, making ads more engaging and respectful. Founded by two ex-Googlers in 2014, we’ve grown to over 600 Seedtaggers across 18 countries, raising €250M to revolutionize digital advertising.
Your Challenge
Represent Seedtag to build relationships and partnerships with agencies and direct customers for local campaigns.
Educating customers (advertisers & agencies) on product features and the benefits of Seedtag so they can apply our solutions to the challenges their customers face.
Generate excitement about our digital advertising platform and increase our product sales through original solutions and proactive pitches to clients.
Develop a deep understanding of the agencies you are responsible for across all clients, verticals and internal agency teams - programmatic, planning, trading and buying.
Identify new business opportunities and new ways of working to achieve preferred partnership status within your agencies.
Achieve and overachieve your quarterly sales goals as set by your manager.
Accurately forecast and report your monthly sales/close sales commercial pipeline.
What You’ll Need to Succeed
Have graduated with a degree or equivalent educational experience.
Have at least 2 years of relevant experience in sales within the advertising industry.
Have established connections within the market, among large hubs and also media agencies.
Can demonstrate a good level of knowledge of the advertising media industry.
Have strong communication skills and are not afraid to take risks.
Are eager and curious to keep learning and have a growth mindset.
Want to join a team and is also able to work independently and autonomously.
Why Join Seedtag?
Growth & Opportunity: A key moment to join with vast career development prospects.
Flexibility: At Seedtag, we work in a hybrid model.
Learning & Development: Online ODILO courses and optional English or Spanish group classes.
Inclusive Culture: We foster a supportive environment that values personal growth.
Fun & Connection: Participate in team activities, company offsites, and more!
Additional Perks
Gympass: Access to wellness apps with certified psychologists, nutritional plans, on-demand classes, and more.
Transportation voucher (8 tickets per month, SPTrans).
Life, health, and dental insurance plans.
Restaurant vouchers.
Ready to join the Seedtag adventure?
Send us your CV and let’s grow together!
At Seedtag, we’re committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We welcome diverse perspectives as they fuel our innovation and growth. Please let us know if you require accommodations during the hiring process and we’ll ensure a positive and accessible experience.

title: Analista Junior de Testes
description:
Como será seu a dia a dia:
Contribuir com as evoluções na forma de trabalho, buscando abrdagens modernas para garantir a qualidade de nossos produtos buscando evolução constante;
Atuar na execução de testes manuais e automatizados, validações junto aos clientes para os módulos e serviços que compõem o ecossistema da nossa solução. Graduação completa na área de tecnologia
Inglês intermediário para compreensão e leitura
Bons conhecimentos e certa experiência comprovada como testador de software, engenheiro de testes de software ou função semelhante;
Conhecimentos em alguma das seguintes ferramentas: Selenium Webdriver, SoapUI/Postman, JUnit/NUnit, JMeter;
Conhecimentos na técnica de desenvolvimento ágil BDD (Behavior Driven Development).

title: Software Engineer Specialist
description:
This is an exciting opportunity to join Magalu Cloud as a Software Engineer focused on Software Defined Storage (SDS). We are building an organization that will be at the center of excellence for distributed technologies, and we are building it in Brasil! With Open Source at the heart of our solutions, we are tackling some of the greatest challenges in cloud computing and we’d like you to be part of it.
This is a key role in our SDS team, responsible for storage solutions offered by our platforms to our end users. A perfect candidate will never be content with today’s solution and would always look at how to improve the product and move the bar higher.
Responsibilities
Design and develop distributed SDS solutions
Lead and mentor junior engineers in the team
Collaborate with other teams to continuously improve product’s performance
Actively participate in upstream communities for the benefit of our organization and community itself
Provide bugfixes and improvements in the software, by working with other teams in the organization and wider Open Source community
Provide guidance and knowledge transfer to teams operating SDS product
Work with junior team members when building documentation for the product
Requirements
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer/Electrical Engineering or related field, or proven equivalent professional experience. Experience must be in software development and/or distributed software maintenance
Experience as a software engineer
Experience working on Ceph based solutions
Understanding of various storage offerings; block, object, filesystem
Familiarity with OpenStack, Incus or LXD
Familiarity with Linux storage layer (VFS, block layer, device mapper)
Experience with Linux development, including debugging in the kernel and userspace
Experience in any two of these programing languages: C/C++, Python, Golang, Rust
Good written and verbal communication skills in Portuguese and English languages
Ability to work within the team, but also individually on dedicated tasks
How to stand out
Upstream patches in Ceph, Linux, OpenStack, Incus or LXD
Experience in building storage solutions for end users
Please remember to attach your CV in English for this position.

title: Enfermeiro Assessor Técnico
description:
Pioneira em soluções médicas fiáveis para melhorar as vidas que tocamos: a Convatec é uma empresa global de produtos e tecnologias médicas, focada em soluções para a gestão de condições crónicas, com posições de liderança no tratamento avançado de feridas, cuidados de ostomia, cuidados de continência e cuidados de infusão. Com cerca de 10.000 colaboradores, fornecemos os nossos produtos e serviços em quase 100 países, unidos pela promessa de solidariedade. As nossas soluções oferecem um conjunto de benefícios, desde a prevenção de infeções e proteção da pele em risco, até melhores resultados para os doentes e redução dos custos com os cuidados. A receita da Convatec em 2023 foi superior a 2 mil milhões de dólares. A empresa faz parte do Índice FTSE 100 (LSE:CTEC). Para saber mais sobre a Convatec, visite
Convatec
.
Sobre a Posição
: Ser um parceiro estratégico do negócio com foco na implementação de ações para difusão de conceitos e implementação das ações estratégicas alinhadas com marketing e time clínico. Treinar e comunicar sobre os conceitos, atributos e benefícios das soluções do portfólio da ConvaTec, tanto para clientes internos quanto externos. Atua alinhado com a gestão da área e do negócio em múltiplos projetos científicos e técnicos locais, apoiando os objetivos e entregas, bem como direcionando suas atividades para atender às necessidades da organização.
Responsabilidades
:
Desenvolver os materiais educativos e aulas a serem utilizados nos diferentes eventos de Educação;
Avaliar e projetar em conjunto com a área clínica, marketing e vendas as necessidades de treinamento da equipe de vendas;
Prestar consultoria aos clientes (médicos, enfermeiros,...,etc.) da área ou de acordo com as necessidades do negócio;
Apoiar o desenvolvimento de casos clínicos, health economics e projetos de educação técnica com impacto no negócio;
Revisar, analisar e comunicar atualizações científicas baseadas em evidências para a equipe de vendas;
Identificar a necessidade de novos conceitos técnicos, a serem desenvolvidos e comunicados à equipa de vendas e profissionais de saúde;
Implementar o plano estratégico incluindo ações de educação de acordo com o planejamento de eventos, congressos e outros em nível técnico;
Revisar e trabalhar em conjunto com assuntos regulatórios e liderança de área no desenvolvimento de materiais locais de educação e treinamento;
Responsável pela aplicação de treinamentos técnicos junto aos clientes da área.
Qualificações
:
Necessário Pós graduação em Estomaterapia ou áreas afins;
Habilidades Necessárias
:
Experiência comprovada com educação e treinamentos no segmento de medical devices;
Excelentes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita;
Conhecimento da indústria de saúde e dispositivos médicos;
3 a 5 anos de experiência em tratamento de feridas e ostomias;
Habilidades numéricas, analíticas e de comunicação (Excel, aplicativos de comunicação,... etc.);
Capacidade demonstrada na condução de programas educacionais;
Capacidade demonstrada de identificar necessidades e propor soluções;
Experiência em gerenciamento de grupos e apresentações públicas;
Orientação de detalhes;
Nível intermediário de inglês.

description:
SPOKEN ENGLISH IS A
MUST!
*Please make sure to submit your resume in English, it will not be accepted otherwise. The interview process will also be conducted in English.
Smart Age Solutions is a Digital Marketing agency located in New York with a branch in Rio de Janeiro. We are looking for new talents in Brazil to build our fast-growing team.
Here at Smart Age, we offer a wide range of results-driven services and don’t settle for less-than-optimum quality. We create precise, fully customizable strategies across Google Search, Social Media, SEO, Retargeting, Display, and Email Marketing, to maximize conversions. Business Development Representative

Proactively lead international sales initiatives by identifying and engaging with prospective clients across diverse markets.
Develop and implement targeted digital marketing strategies, driving lead conversion and customer acquisition.
Analyze and interpret data insights and performance metrics to continuously refine sales and marketing strategies, iterating on successful approaches to maximize conversion rates and revenue growth.

Fluent in English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Charismatic and persuasive demeanor, with the ability to proactively engage potential clients, build rapport, and convincingly articulate the value proposition of our products or services.
Demonstrated track record of success in sales, with a proven ability to convert leads into clients and drive revenue growth.

Advertising Services

Full-time

title: Third Engineer (Ilhas Marshall)
description:
Localização: Rio de Janeiro – Embarque Offshore (bandeira Ilhas Marshall)

Departamento: Engenharia

Escala: Conforme programação da embarcação

Resumo da Posição:

Buscamos um(a) 3rd Engineer Officer (também conhecido como 2nd Assistant Engineer – OICEW, STCW III/1) para atuação em unidade offshore com bandeira das Ilhas Marshall. O profissional será responsável por auxiliar na operação, monitoramento e manutenção dos sistemas de propulsão e equipamentos da praça de máquinas, atuando em conformidade com as exigências internacionais (STCW) e com os certificados exigidos pelas Ilhas Marshall.

Qualificações Necessárias:

  • Certificação STCW III/1 – 3rd Engineer / 2nd Assistant Engineer (OICEW), sem limitação de potência ou área geográfica
  • Mínimo de 4 anos de experiência na indústria naval
  • 1 a 2 anos de experiência comprovada como 4o Oficial de Máquinas / 3rd Assistant Engineer (OICEW)
  • Formação completa em Academia ou Universidade Marítima reconhecida
  • Conclusão de todos os treinamentos e certificações obrigatórias, conforme matriz de treinamento

Certificados Obrigatórios – Ilhas Marshall:

  • Officer in Charge of Engineering Watch – Marshall Islands (CRP1367)
  • STCW Basic Safety Training (BST) (CRP339)
  • Proficiency in Survival Craft – Marshall Islands (PSCMI)
  • STCW PSCRB – Proficiency in Survival Craft & Rescue Boat (CRP251)
  • STCW Fast Rescue Boat / Craft (CRP951)
  • Advanced Fire Fighting (CRP1015)
  • Medical First Aid (CRP530)
  • HUET – Helicopter Underwater Escape (OPITO Approved) (CRP817)
  • ISPS Security Familiarization (A-VI/6)
  • DP Awareness (CRP960)
  • Engine Resource Management (ERM)

Certificações Complementares – Normas Brasileiras (NR):

  • NR-12 – Operação de Máquinas e Equipamentos (8h) (CRP1061)
  • NR-33 – Espaço Confinado (16h) (CRP859)
  • NR-35 – Trabalho em Altura (8h) (CRP565)
  • NR-37 – Treinamento de Primeira Embarcação (6h) (CRP1350)
  • NR-37 – Controle de Qualidade da Água em Unidades Offshore (16h) (CRP1602)

Exame Médico:

  • Certificado de Exame Médico Marítimo válido (CRP582), conforme STCW e diretrizes da empresa

Responsabilidades Principais:

  • Apoiar na operação e manutenção de todos os sistemas da praça de máquinas
  • Cumprir os turnos de plantão de máquinas conforme designado (OICEW)
  • Garantir a conformidade com padrões de segurança, meio ambiente e regulamentos internacionais
  • Auxiliar no diagnóstico de falhas técnicas e na resolução de problemas operacionais
  • Preencher os registros e relatórios técnicos conforme procedimentos internos

Desejável:

  • Boa comunicação em inglês técnico
  • Perfil proativo, organizado e com foco em segurança operacional
  • Experiência anterior em embarcações com bandeira estrangeira (preferencialmente Ilhas Marshall)

title: Product Owner de Projetos de Dados Sênior | Gerencia de dados BU
description:
Descrição da vaga

Com uma trajetória de 95 anos, a Americanas S.A. está presente na vida de milhões de brasileiros.

Nossas +1600 lojas físicas estão distribuídas por todos os estados do Brasil, em mais de 800 cidades, levando nossos produtos e serviços a mais de 40 milhões de clientes em todo o país.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Nesse time, você terá a oportunidade de:

  • Conduzir reuniões de levantamento de requisitos com as áreas de negócio.
  • Apoiar a definição e o estudo de alternativas de soluções de TI.
  • Elaborar e conduzir agendas de status report operacional e executivo.
  • Comunicar-se de forma clara e objetiva com diferentes stakeholders.
  • Aplicar raciocínio lógico na análise e resolução de problemas.

Requisitos e qualificações

O que esperamos de você para essa vaga:

  • Foco em projetos de dados em TI, como Analytics, migração de dados, inteligência artificial, criação de indicadores e dashboards de negócio.
  • Trabalhar com o Jira de forma avançada, incluindo cadastro de épicos, gestão de histórias e acompanhamento de sprints.
  • Ter conhecimento desejável nos segmentos de varejo, marketplace ou financeiro.
  • Ser altamente organizado para garantir o planejamento e a execução eficiente dos projetos.

Será um diferencial, caso você conheça:

  • Inglês avancado;
  • nteligencia artificial;
  • Certificação Scrum /PMI;

OBS: Nossos processos seletivos estão sendo conduzidos totalmente online, portanto, fique atento nos emails e no spam.

Informações adicionais

Nossos benefícios:

Somos adeptos ao regime e benefícios CLT, oferecemos:

  • Vale Refeição;
  • Plano de saúde Bradesco;
  • Plano odontológico Amil;
  • Wellhub;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Fazemos nossa proposta salarial de acordo com o nosso plano de cargos e salários, sua pretensão salarial e avaliação técnica;
  • Somos uma Empresa Cidadã: 180 dias de licença maternidade e 20 dias licença paternidade;
  • Descontos em nossas lojas físicas, após o período de experiência;
  • Allya: app que oferece descontos em quase 30 mil estabelecimentos por todo Brasil, ex: farmácia, restaurante, salão, academia, etc;
  • Ambiente colaborativo: perfeito pra ensinar e aprender muito.

Local de Trabalho: Rio de Janeiro

QUEM SOMOS

Quem Somos:​

Somos a Americanas, uma das maiores varejistas do país, com mais de 95 anos de história. Nossa marca, amada pelos brasileiros, tem o propósito de resolver a vida das famílias de maneira simples e descomplicada. A integração das mais de 1.600 lojas, presentes em todos os estados, e um e-commerce que complementa a experiência do físico nos permitem a realização de uma estratégia de vendas multicanal e eficiente, com foco na geração de caixa e na rentabilidade. Venha construir o futuro com a gente!​

N

osso Jeito:​N

ossa cultura é centrada no cliente, e buscamos constantemente soluções para aprimorar sua experiência. Valorizamos um jeito de trabalhar simples e descomplicado, que realmente gera impacto positivo na vida das pessoas. Aqui, incentivamos o trabalho em equipe e a troca de ideias, pois acreditamos que é assim que crescemos juntos, tanto como profissionais quanto como pessoas.​V

a

lores e Propósito:​No

sso propósito é resolver a vida das pessoas, de maneira simples e descomplicada, guiada por valores autênticos e que representem a nossa gente. Buscamos entregar resultados com integridade, sempre servindo o cliente da melhor forma; priorizamos a conveniência em cada experiência, seja nas lojas, no site ou no coração de milhões de famílias; valorizamos a pluralidade e a resiliência, além de reconhecer e cuidar das nossas pessoas. Acima de tudo, nos comprometemos a ter um impacto positivo em tudo o que fazemos​.
D

i

versidade e inclusão:​A

Americanas S.A. acredita que diferentes perspectivas enriquecem o ambiente de trabalho. Por isso, temos o objetivo de promover um lugar cada vez mais diverso, inclusivo e acolhedor. Estamos construindo a cada dia uma cultura com base no respeito e valorização das diferenças, encorajando as pessoas a serem quem elas são, independente de gênero, etnia, raça, orientação sexual, religião ou deficiência. Nós acreditamos na integração das diversas culturas e tradições do Brasil, e queremos refletir a riqueza e a pluralidade do nosso país. Todas as nossas oportunidades são trabalhadas com base nesse princípio.​

title: Coordenador de desenvolvimento de negócios
description:
Atividades:

• Planejamento e Execução de Vendas: Desenvolver e implementar planos de vendas eficazes, estabelecendo metas e monitorando o desempenho para garantir o cumprimento dos objetivos.

• Desenvolvimento de Negócios: Identificar e explorar novas oportunidades de mercado, estabelecendo parcerias estratégicas e expandindo a base de clientes.

- Relacionamento com o Cliente: Realizar visitas de pós-venda para garantir a satisfação e fidelização, além de identificar novas oportunidades de negócio.

- Conhecimento profundo do mercado e produtos odontológicos.

title: Project Engineer
description:
Project Engineer – Substations & High Voltage

(ENGLISH SPEAKERS)

Location: The Netherlands (on-site), 1-2 - year contract with potential of permanent employment, NOT project/freelance

Are you passionate about large-scale infrastructure and high-voltage energy systems? Join a forward-thinking engineering team dedicated to delivering cutting-edge solutions in substations (up to 500kV) and energy transmission projects across global markets.

We're looking for an experienced Project Engineer to support the design, development, and delivery of substation and high-voltage projects. You’ll collaborate with a multidisciplinary team, contribute to energy transition solutions, and bring excellence to our electromechanical and protection systems.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop basic and executive electromechanical designs for high-voltage substations (69kV to 500kV)
  • Prepare and analyze layout drawings, grounding mesh, cable routing, and auxiliary systems (AC/DC)
  • Design single-line, three-line, and interconnection diagrams
  • Ensure compliance with international standards (IEC, ANSI, IEEE, ABNT)
  • Perform technical documentation review and approval (FATs, BOMs, technical specs)
  • Interface with clients, suppliers, and cross-functional engineering teams
  • Contribute to engineering reports including ROI, CAPEX, and technical feasibility

What We’re Looking For:

  • Degree in Electrical Engineering or related field
  • Minimum 4+ years of experience in high-voltage substation design (preferred: 230kV to 500kV)
  • Proficiency with AutoCAD (See Electrical, Eplan P8 or similar is a plus)
  • Familiarity with SCADA, protection and control systems
  • Solid knowledge of substation equipment: CTs, PTs, surge arresters, circuit breakers, transformers, disconnectors
  • Experience with software like CYMCAP, DiaLUX, PVsyst (nice to have)
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work in multicultural environments
  • English proficiency required; Portuguese or Spanish is a plus

Bonus:

  • Experience with renewable projects (photovoltaic farms, hybrid systems)
  • Exposure to EPC projects and multidisciplinary coordination
  • Understanding of ESG practices in engineering

Why Join Us:

  • Work with industry leaders in power and energy systems
  • Get involved in international projects with real impact
  • Grow within a dynamic and mission-driven company
  • Remote flexibility and a collaborative, innovation-driven culture

Who is Xelvin?

Xelvin is a Dutch consultancy company specializing in Engineering and Technical Trades. We hire Artisans, National Degree, Bachelor, Masters and PHD candidates with a background in Mechatronics, Electronics, Electrical, Mechanical, Automotive and Physics. Our focus is within the High-Tech and Manufacturing industry in Eindhoven region.

Xelvin is specialized in International Recruitment, within Europe and beyond. In the past years we have helped over a thousand candidates from more than 50 different nationalities with finding their perfect job here in the Netherlands and are striving to help so many more!

As Xelvin we hire candidates for a specific position for a set amount of time, after which a permanent contract with our client is granted and the candidates automatically transfers.

What do we offer?

Contract wise:

· 1-2 year contract of 40 hours per week (with potential of long-term employment).

· 25 paid holidays a year (+ potential ADV days)

· Public holidays, with a maximum of 7 per year, which are paid by Xelvin.

· Holiday allowance of 8.33% (instead of 8,0%) over your total gross annual income. Paid each year in May.

· Overtime and shift allowance will be paid by Xelvin accordingly.

· Travel allowance of €0,23 per km, for the use of travelling to work and back home.

· Competitive salary (based on level of education and experience)

Onboarding & benefits:

· Your 1st house in the Netherlands will be supported by Xelvin, with the help of our Housing Consultant (we help you find accommodation). In case of having to pay the 1st months rent or potential deposit, Xelvin is willing to pay it for you upfront, after which we’ll set up a loan agreement, for you to pay us back in terms.

· A relocation assistance allowance of €1000 - €3000,00 NET will be paid to you, to assist with the cost of relocating to the Netherlands.

· You (and your family/partner) will be picked up at the airport or train station by your consultant/ recruiter after your arrival and will be taken to your new house.

· Onboarding: we’ll advise you on how to set up a Dutch bank account, apply for health insurance, getting a Dutch BSN number, writing in with a dentist and general practitioner and other useful or necessary cases to arrange.

· New Hire Dinner organized for all newly recruited engineers to make them aware of our Dutch tax system and explaining the Dutch payslip.

· A few social gatherings with all Xelvin employees and recruited engineers;

o New Years drink at the local PSV stadium, where you’ll get a tour of the building and beverages and bites are served.

o Summer BBQ at the Evoluon, where you can grow your social circle and dance to some nice music while enjoying the food.

Integração com E-Social:

  • Atuar no controle e envio do evento S-2240 do eSocial, realizando cadastro, correções, auditoria e atualização de dados no sistema de gestão (EPIs, EPCs, GHEs, riscos ambientais, códigos e metodologias).

Governança e Melhoria Contínua:

  • Participar de reuniões com áreas envolvidas, apresentando dados e recomendações técnicas;
  • Revisar procedimentos internos via Greendocs, com base em auditorias e inspeções;
  • Integrar os programas de proteção auditiva e respiratória aos programas de gerenciamento de riscos;
  • Garantir a execução e o monitoramento dos planos de ação dos PGRTAs.

Requisitos necessários:

  • Formação técnica em Segurança do Trabalho com registro ativo;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em Higiene Ocupacional, NRs e gestão de riscos ambientais;
  • Vivência com eSocial (evento S-2240) e rotinas relacionadas;
  • Habilidade para analisar criticamente documentos técnicos e realizar auditorias internas;

Nosso Futebol, part of Sporty Group, is a comprehensive sports broadcasting platform based in Brazil, delivering over 400 live football matches per year. We are rapidly becoming Brazil’s most dynamic football broadcaster, the home of Série C, select Série B and Bundesliga matches, regional tournaments, the European League of Football (ELF), and women’s football, with new content and offerings launched regularly.

As a Traffic Analyst at Nosso Futebol, you will be responsible for ensuring the proper scheduling and execution of the channel’s programming and commercial breaks. Buscamos entregar resultados com integridade, sempre servindo o cliente da melhor forma; priorizamos a conveniência em cada experiência, seja nas lojas, no site ou no coração de milhões de famílias; valorizamos a pluralidade e a resiliência, além de reconhecer e cuidar das nossas pessoas. Acima de tudo, nos comprometemos a ter um impacto positivo em tudo o que fazemos​.

Diversidade e Inclusão:​

A Americanas S.A. acredita que diferentes perspectivas enriquecem o ambiente de trabalho. Por isso, temos o objetivo de promover um lugar cada vez mais diverso, inclusivo e acolhedor. Estamos construindo a cada dia uma cultura com base no respeito e valorização das diferenças, encorajando as pessoas a serem quem elas são, independente de gênero, etnia, raça, orientação sexual, religião ou deficiência. Nós acreditamos na integração das diversas culturas e tradições do Brasil, e queremos refletir a riqueza e a pluralidade do nosso país. Todas as nossas oportunidades são trabalhadas com base nesse princípio.​

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Nesse time, você terá a oportunidade de:

  • Manusear grandes volumes de dados, garantindo a integridade e qualidade dos dados. Com orientação para resolver problemas complexos de inconsistência de dados;
  • Realizar análises de dados para identificar padrões básicos e anomalias, utilizando ferramentas e técnicas predefinidas. Focar em tarefas como análises descritivas e diagnóstico de dados com supervisão;
  • Criar dashboards e relatórios, com foco na clareza e precisão das informações. Responsável pela geração de relatórios periódicos e dashboards padrão utilizando a plataforma Looker Studio;
  • Fornecer suporte analítico básico para a tomada de decisões, focando na clareza e apresentação de dados relevantes. Participar de reuniões de equipe como ouvinte e contribuidor;
  • Auxiliar no desenvolvimento de modelos preditivos simples sob orientação de analistas mais experientes. Envolver-se na coleta de dados, preparação de datasets e testes para modelagem;
  • Apoiar a investigação de incidentes e anomalias identificados, realizando análises preliminares e compilando dados para revisões mais detalhadas;

Requisitos e qualificações

O que esperamos de você para essa vaga:

  • Conhecimento em SQL para consultas e manipulação de dados;
  • Experiência na criação de dashboards;
  • Conhecimento das boas práticas de DataViz;
  • Compreensão dos conceitos básicos de estatística e análise de dados;
  • Conhecimento básico de programação e ferramentas de ETL.

Será um diferencial, caso você conheça:

  • Conhecimento básico do bigquery;
  • Conhecimento básico Looker Studio;
  • Conhecimento básico Apache Airflow/Google Cloud Composer;
  • Conhecimento básico de Python para análise de dados/engenharia de dados.

OBS: Nossos processos seletivos estão sendo conduzidos totalmente online, portanto, fique atento nos emails e no spam.
